name: Image Segmentation Benchmark (2001)
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate image segmentation algorithms and overall performance of vision systems on segmentation tasks.
evaluation_method: boundary F-measure (F1) (with precision/recall); region-based metrics (e.g., Rand index, variation of information) are also reported
reputation: A classic, widely cited early benchmark for image segmentation (e.g., BSDS-style evaluation) that had strong historical influence on low-level vision research.
notes: Small, curated dataset (relatively few images) and focused on low-level boundary/region quality; non-LLM benchmark; some metrics/datasets from this era are saturated by modern methods and may not reflect large-scale scene segmentation performance.
